question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Full of beans
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Full of beans"** means being lively, energetic, and enthusiastic. (जीवन और ऊर्जा से भरपूर)

 
 
• **Example: **The children were **full of beans **after the birthday party, running around and laughing.
 
 
 
• **"Full of energy and life"** refers to someone who is very lively and active, showing a lot of enthusiasm and vigor. (जीवन और ऊर्जा से भरपूर)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the long day, she was still **full of energy and life,** ready to go dancing.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bad drinking habits** (खराब पीने की आदतें): Refers to the unhealthy or excessive consumption of alcoholic beverages.

 
 
• **Example:** His bad drinking habits have started to affect his work and personal life.
 
 
 
• **Very dramatic** (बहुत नाटकीय): Refers to someone who is overly emotional or theatrical in their behavior.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a very dramatic way of telling stories, always adding extra details for effect.
 
 
 
• **Full of secrets** (रहस्यों से भरा): Refers to someone who has a lot of undisclosed or hidden information.
 
 
• **Example:** He seems full of secrets, never quite revealing his true intentions.
 
 

 

39:Tadb,
The correct answer is** Option 2.**
